### Day 267: Acts 19:8-10
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-267-acts-19-8-10.html
Passage: Acts 19:8-10
Points:
- When faced with stubborn opposition in the synagogue, Paul withdrew to disciple believers daily in a lecture hall.
- Focused discipleship yielded widespread fruit, spreading the gospel throughout the entire province within two years.
- A small band of well-trained believers can accomplish far more for the kingdom than large, untrained crowds.
- God supernaturally multiplies faithful ministry beyond human ability and labor.
- God provides visible signs of His work to strengthen faith in His invisible care.
